figs.name: reflux-ratio-column-overhead-diagram
figs.alt: reflux ratio in a distillation column with condenser, reflux drum, reflux and distillate flows
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing a distillation column overhead: vapor to condenser, 120 kmol/h into the reflux drum, 80 kmol/h reflux back and 40 kmol/h distillate, so R is 2.
figs.after_h2: What Exactly Is Reflux in a Distillation Column

figs.name: reflux-ratio-troubleshooting-flowchart
figs.alt: reflux troubleshooting flowchart for off spec product, tray flooding and temperature oscillation
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how to check reflux problems: raise R for off spec product, cut R for flooding and retune the reflux valve loop for oscillation.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 570" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Reflux troubleshooting flowchart for off spec product, flooding and oscillation</title>
<rect width="800" height="570" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#365314" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Reflux Problems: What to Check</text>
<rect x="80" y="60" width="300" height="50" rx="10" fill="#4d7c0f" stroke="#4d7c0f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="230.0" y="91.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Check column at current R</text>
<line x1="230" y1="110" x2="230" y2="123" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="230,125.0 370.0,170 230,215.0 90.0,170" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4d7c0f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="230" y="165.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Product</text>
<text x="230" y="187.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">off spec?</text>
<line x1="370" y1="170" x2="448" y2="170" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="408" y="160" font-size="17" fill="#365314" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="450" y="136" width="330" height="68" rx="10" fill="#f7fee7" stroke="#4d7c0f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="615.0" y="164.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Reflux too low</text>
<text x="615.0" y="187.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">raise R for more contact</text>
<line x1="230" y1="215" x2="230" y2="243" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="244" y="236" font-size="17" fill="#365314" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<polygon points="230,245.0 370.0,290 230,335.0 90.0,290" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4d7c0f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="230" y="285.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Trays</text>
<text x="230" y="307.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">flooding?</text>
<line x1="370" y1="290" x2="448" y2="290" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="408" y="280" font-size="17" fill="#365314" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="450" y="256" width="330" height="68" rx="10" fill="#f7fee7" stroke="#4d7c0f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="615.0" y="284.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Reflux too high</text>
<text x="615.0" y="307.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">cut R to reduce liquid load</text>
<line x1="230" y1="335" x2="230" y2="363" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="244" y="356" font-size="17" fill="#365314" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<polygon points="230,365.0 370.0,410 230,455.0 90.0,410" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4d7c0f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="230" y="405.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Temperature</text>
<text x="230" y="427.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">oscillates?</text>
<line x1="370" y1="410" x2="448" y2="410" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="408" y="400" font-size="17" fill="#365314" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="450" y="376" width="330" height="68" rx="10" fill="#f7fee7" stroke="#4d7c0f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="615.0" y="404.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Control instability</text>
<text x="615.0" y="427.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">retune reflux valve loop</text>
<line x1="230" y1="455" x2="230" y2="488" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="244" y="476" font-size="17" fill="#365314" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="80" y="490" width="300" height="60" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4d7c0f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="230.0" y="514.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Hold optimum R</text>
<text x="230.0" y="538.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">1.2 to 1.5 × Rmin</text>
<text x="615" y="505" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Higher R means more steam</text>
<text x="615" y="529" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">and more cooling water</text>
</svg>
